title: 第12章 后天功法

content_zh:
“叶儿！”萧天雄满脸红光，在选婚比武上，萧叶一人力压同辈，可谓给萧家村赢足了脸面。
特别是最后石战和吴狮两人，为了让萧叶成为他们孙女婿大打出手的一幕，让萧天雄心中乐开了花。
他萧家村，也终于出现了一位真正的天才。
“我想问问你，你怎么就突然踏入后天境了？”萧天雄好奇的问道。
萧叶目光闪动，他早就猜到萧天雄会问这个问题，毕竟昏迷三个月，一醒来就进入了后天境，这也太吓人了。
“村长爷爷，我这三个月做了一个梦，我在梦里不停的修炼，等我醒来，就踏入后天境了。”萧叶在回来的路上，就准备好了这套说辞。
这样的说法是最为保险的，因为谁也不能到他的梦中，一探究竟。关于时间之塔的存在，他不可能说出来。
“梦中修炼？”萧天雄一瞪眼，感觉有些匪夷所思。
他沉吟了许久，才缓缓道：“真灵大陆浩瀚无边，真是什么奇怪的事情都有可能发生，我也不多问了。”
“不过，我得向你道歉，把你的蛟蛇血，给了萧腾使用。”萧天雄诚恳的道歉。
见萧天雄没有在这个问题上多做纠缠，萧叶顿时松了口气。
“村长爷爷，你也不用道歉。不把蛟蛇血给萧腾用的话，等我苏醒，蛟蛇血的能量早就消耗光了，而且我没有蛟蛇血，不是一样踏入了后天境吗？
萧天雄开怀的笑了，心中的一丝担忧，终于消散了。眼前的少年不但天赋过人，还有着广阔的胸襟，远超一般的同龄人，让他越看越满意。
“你已经踏入后天境了，走，我带你去村子里的藏功楼。以后村子内的藏功楼，对你随意开放。”萧天雄起身向外走去。
萧叶心中一喜，他对后天境的功法期待很久了。而且以他现在的修为，基础战技猛虎拳有些寒酸了。毕竟一个人的修为即使再强，如果没有匹配的战技，将难以发挥最强的实力。
藏功楼其实就是一间普通的屋子，为了防止盗窃，门口彻夜都有村民把守。
“村长！”把守的村民见到萧天雄，连忙道。
“嗯。”萧天雄淡淡点头，然后带着萧叶走了进去。
藏功楼内摆放着两排书架，书架上摆放着一本本小册子。
萧天雄举步走到一排书架前，取下了五本册子，摆放在桌子上：“这五本，就是后天境的功法了，任何一本都足够让人踏入先天境。”

萧叶连忙拿起册子翻看起来。
滴水功，可以利用体内五条经脉壮大真气，修炼出来的真气如水滴般连绵不绝。
莽牛劲，可以利用体内六条经脉壮大真气，修炼出来的真气具有强大的爆发力。
混元功，可以利用体内九条经脉壮大真气，修炼出来的真气凝实无比。
一连翻看了五本后天功法，萧叶疑惑了起来。
“怎么每本功法，利用的经脉数量都不一样？”萧叶问道。
五本后天功法中，混元功利用的经脉最多，达到了九条之多。
萧天雄笑道：“后天境是让真气在经脉中周天循环，以此来壮大真气。利用的经脉越多，真气也就越浑厚。”
萧叶闻言恍然，道：“村长爷爷，你的意思也就是说，混元功最强了？”
“对，但修炼的难度也越大。”
“后天境分九重，是一个不断锤炼真气的过程，锤炼产生九次质变，才有机会踏入先天境。”
“而每一次质变之前，就必须将所利用的经脉灌满真气。混元功是强，但是要将九条经脉灌满，可不是那么容易的。”萧天雄说道。
萧叶听了萧天雄的话，顿时明白了过来。
后天境武者体内的经脉，就像是河道，而真气就是河道中的河水。河道的数量越多，要灌满它所需要的河水就越多。
但同样，河道越多，能够储存的河水也就越多，萧叶深知这点。
“叶儿，我们村子中的武者，几乎都尝试修炼过混元功，但是因为难度太大而放弃，转修其他的功法。
“所以我劝你，还是修炼莽牛劲吧。以你的资质，应该很快就能突破。”萧天雄提醒道。
听着村长的话，萧叶手中却拿起混元功，坚定道：“村长爷爷，我就选这本。”
萧天雄眉头一皱，看来这小子是不撞南墙不回头啊。
“胡闹！你这样只会白白浪费时间，多走很长的弯路！”萧天雄大喝道。

萧家村祖祖辈辈积累下来的经验，都是如此，他自然不忍心萧叶重蹈覆辙。

content_en:
"Ye'er!" Xiao Tianxiong's face was flushed. In the marriage selection competition, Xiao Ye single-handedly defeated his peers, which can be said to have won enough face for Xiaojia Village.
Especially the last scene where Shi Zhan and Wu Shi fought to make Xiao Ye their grandson-in-law made Xiao Tianxiong happy.
In his Xiaojiacun, a true genius finally appeared.
"I want to ask you, why did you suddenly enter the acquired realm?" Xiao Tianxiong asked curiously.
Xiao Ye's eyes flashed. He had already guessed that Xiao Tianxiong would ask this question. After all, he had been in a coma for three months and entered the acquired realm as soon as he woke up. This was too scary.
"Grandpa Village Chief, I have had a dream in the past three months. I have been practicing in the dream. When I wake up, I will enter the acquired realm." Xiao Ye prepared this rhetoric on the way back.
This statement is the safest, because no one can go into his dream to find out. It was impossible for him to say anything about the existence of the Tower of Time.
"Cultivation in a dream?" Xiao Tianxiong stared, feeling a little weird.
He pondered for a long time and then slowly said: "The True Spirit Continent is vast and boundless. Strange things can happen, so I won't ask any more questions."
"However, I have to apologize to you for giving your snake blood to Xiao Teng." Xiao Tianxiong apologized sincerely.
Seeing that Xiao Tianxiong did not dwell on this issue, Xiao Ye breathed a sigh of relief.
"Grandpa Village Chief, you don't need to apologize. If I don't give the snake blood to Xiao Teng, the energy of the snake blood will have been exhausted by the time I wake up. And since I don't have the snake blood, wouldn't I have also entered the acquired realm?
Xiao Tianxiong smiled heartily, and the worry in his heart finally dissipated. The young man in front of him was not only extremely talented, but also had a broad mind, far beyond the average of his peers, which made him more and more satisfied.
"You have already entered the Houtian realm. Come on, I will take you to the Tibetan Gong Building in the village. From now on, the Tibetan Gong Building in the village will be open to you at will. "Xiao Tianxiong stood up and walked out.
Xiao Ye felt happy. He had been looking forward to the acquired skills for a long time. And with his current level of cultivation, the basic combat skill Tiger Fist is a bit shabby. After all, no matter how strong a person's cultivation is, if he does not have matching combat skills, it will be difficult to exert his strongest strength.
The Zanggong Building is actually an ordinary house. In order to prevent theft, villagers guard the door all night long.
"Village chief! "The guarding villagers saw Xiao Tianxiong and said quickly.
"Hmm. "Xiao Tianxiong nodded lightly, and then walked in with Xiao Ye.
There are two rows of bookshelves in the Zanggong Building, and there are booklets on the bookshelves.
Xiao Tianxiong walked up to a row of bookshelves, took down five books, and placed them on the table: "These five books are the skills of the acquired realm. Any one of them is enough for someone to step into the innate realm. "
Xiao Ye quickly picked up the book and flipped through it.
The dripping skill can use the five meridians in the body to strengthen the true energy. The practiced true energy is as continuous as water droplets.
Mang Niu Jin can use the six meridians in the body to strengthen the true energy, and the true energy cultivated has powerful explosive power.
Hunyuan Gong can use the nine meridians in the body to strengthen the true energy, and the true energy that is cultivated is extremely solid.
After reading five acquired skills in a row, Xiao Ye became confused.
"Why does each skill use a different number of meridians? "Xiao Ye asked.
Among the five acquired skills, Hunyuan Gong uses the most meridians, reaching as many as nine.
Xiao Tianxiong smiled and said: "The acquired state is to allow the true energy to circulate throughout the meridians, in order to strengthen the true energy. The more meridians used, the stronger the true energy will be. "
Xiao Ye was stunned when he heard this and said: "Grandpa Village Chief, do you mean that Hunyuan Gong is the strongest? "
"Yes, but it is also more difficult to practice. "
"The acquired realm is divided into nine levels. It is a process of constantly tempering the true energy. Only by tempering and producing nine qualitative changes can one have the opportunity to step into the innate realm. "
"Before every qualitative change, there must beThe meridians used must be filled with true energy. Hunyuan Gong is strong, but it is not that easy to fill the nine meridians. "Xiao Tianxiong said.
Xiao Ye suddenly understood after hearing Xiao Tianxiong's words.
The meridians in the body of the acquired warrior are like rivers, and the true energy is the water in the rivers. The greater the number of channels, the more river water is required to fill them.
But similarly, the more rivers there are, the more river water can be stored. Xiao Ye knows this very well.
"Ye'er, almost all the warriors in our village have tried to practice Hunyuan Gong, but gave up because it was too difficult and switched to other techniques.
"So I advise you to practice Mang Niu Jin. With your qualifications, you should be able to break through soon." Xiao Tianxiong reminded.
After listening to the village chief's words, Xiao Ye picked up the Hunyuan Gong in his hand and said firmly: "Grandpa, village chief, I will choose this one."
Xiao Tianxiong frowned. It seemed that this boy would never look back until he hit the wall.
"Nonsense! You will only waste time and take a long detour!" Xiao Tianxiong shouted.
The experience accumulated by the ancestors of Xiaojia Village for generations was like this. Naturally, he couldn't bear Xiao Ye to make the same mistakes again.
